video_title: Cameron Carr Went From Baylor WALK-ON to Lakers 1st-Round Pick | 24th Pick | EP6

quotes.speaker: Chrissy Carr
quotes.summary_phrase: Chrissy Carr on the competitive nature of the Carr family
quotes.excerpt: Everything was just a competition everywhere, so we're very competitive.
quotes.quote: We competed at everything, whether that was first one to hide the snacks once mom brought home groceries or family dinners. Everything was just a competition everywhere, so we're very competitive.

quotes.speaker: Chris Carr
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Carr on the importance of surrounding Cameron with professional mentors
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to surround you with these people so they can all invest in you.
quotes.quote: I'm going to surround you with these people so they can all invest in you. Everybody along the way, the Chris Humphreys, Michael Beasleys. He's been around so many people that he has seen the professional game from the lens of making a thousand pocket passes in the summertime to Kevin Garnett and John Lauer and Chris Humphreys on pick and pop situations.

quotes.speaker: Tanya Carr
quotes.summary_phrase: Tanya Carr on the process of Cameron Carr becoming a walk-on at Baylor
quotes.excerpt: Your plan is you're going to go to class, pay your tuition, and go to Coach Drew.
quotes.quote: When I left him there, I go, so your plan is you're going to go to class, and then you have to pay your tuition, and then you literally have to go to Coach Drew and ask him to be a walk-on. And that was the process.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Carr
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Carr on the shock of being traded to the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: You're going to get drafted here by the Knicks, but you're going to go to the Lakers.
quotes.quote: Drew Gross, my agent, he turned around and told me, you're going to get drafted here by the Knicks, but you're going to go to the Lakers. And I was like, oh, all right. And he's like, you good? And I could tell I was a little shocked, but when I finally did hear my name called, it was great to see the reaction of my parents and my family.
